title: From Build Success to Admissible Proof: Evidence-Typed Governance for a Mixed Lean and Executable Formula Corpus
description:
PREPRINT - NOT PEER REVIEWED. This work presents an evidence-typed governance method for separating build success, declaration presence, executable tests, proof obligations, refutations, and admitted formal proof in a mixed Lean and executable formula corpus.

The frozen manuscript is 24 pages. The manuscript and documentation are licensed CC BY 4.0. Bundled software and code snapshots retain their Apache-2.0 notices.
